title: Neon Salvage
prompt: Update the existing Neon Salvage game with one scoring mechanic: a salvage-chain multiplier. Begin at x1. Each collected core awards 10 times the current multiplier, then increases the multiplier by one, capped at x5. Taking hull damage resets the multiplier to x1. Add a clear visible NEXT CORE multiplier in the HUD and brief feedback when the chain is lost. Restart/replay resets the multiplier to x1. Expose multiplier as a copied scalar in the existing read-only snapshot for inspection. Keep the existing one-minute game, hull/debris behavior, controls, responsive layout, pause/restart, style and stable URL working. Implement this in the existing game files; do not make a second game.
acceptance: First and second consecutive pickups award 10 then 20 points; the next pickup multiplier rises visibly, capped at x5.
A hull-damaging collision resets the multiplier to x1 and gives clear chain-loss feedback.
Restart and replay reset score, time, hull and multiplier; pause freezes simulation.
The existing touch controls, one-minute end condition, visual style and game URL remain functional.
